name: Handwritten Annotations. Category: Drawing and Illustration. Provenance: explicit, since the source directly names or describes this visual direction.
visualIdentity: Explicitly described as handwritten lettering, underlines, arrows, circles, and simple diagrams with slightly uneven marker edges. Ink and accent colors are restricted. Annotations draw in explanatory order: the subject is pointed to first, then the note appears, with enough time to read.
suitableUses: Explicit: annotating an existing subject, such as markup over a screenshot or a document walkthrough. Explicit: pairing with a chart or line art when that subject must be drawn. Inferred: product callouts and explanatory lessons, where a subject exists to point at. Not suitable without a subject to annotate.
limitations: Explicit: it needs an annotated subject, and alone it fits markup-over-screenshot or document walkthroughs. Restrict ink and accent colors. Avoid too many simultaneous notes, obscured values, and handwritten paragraphs. Rough.js cannot generate authentic handwriting, and roughness should not touch precise grids, clean vectors, product UI, or existing assets unless authorized. Hachure fills do not imitate real pencil or print media. Unspecified: duration and resolution limits.
palette: Status: a style-compatible suggestion, used only when no approved palette is supplied. Tokens: background #FFFDF7, foreground #233346, accent_1 #B54A3E. The accent is reserved for annotations. Contrast: foreground on background 12.639; accent_1 with background 5.144 (two-color checks only). Gradients are disabled. Task-supplied exact colors override these tokens, and assets must not be recolored.
motionAndInteraction: Explicit cues: strokes and notes reveal in explanatory order, with arrows and circles landing on the subject before text appears. Suggested methods: SVG stroke reveals via GSAP DrawSVGPlugin or stroke-dashoffset, with Motion optional. Video motion derives from seekable composition time. Interactive delivery is unspecified, though examples suggest toggled annotation layers or focus-driven hotspots with keyboard navigation.
audio: Unspecified in the source; no audio is assigned to this style. Inferred: restrained voiceover or silence with reading holds may suit explanatory annotation. Any sound should not compete with speech or essential on-screen text. Music, effects, and ambience are optional suggestions, and speech intelligibility must be verified.
assetRequirements: Explicit: a subject to annotate, such as a screenshot, document, chart, or line art. Handwriting requires approved handwritten assets or readable body-text fonts, loaded before rendering. Audio requires task-provided or authorized sources. Unspecified: required file formats, dimensions, and asset counts beyond optional examples.
combinations: Suggested with style-097 (clean charts): the chart builds in #233346, and an accent circle marks one takeaway per state, avoiding invented trends. Suggested with style-027 (uniform-weight line art): arrows land on parts before notes appear, with no color fills in the line art. Both pairings are source suggestions, not requirements.
productionApproach: Pipeline: HyperFrames is the primary route for composition, timing, validation, and export. Remotion is a fallback only when HyperFrames is unavailable or a verified limitation exists, and the reason must be recorded. Visuals: SVG and HTML/CSS, with optional tldraw and Rough.js. Motion: GSAP DrawSVGPlugin for stroke reveals. Chroma.js validates palette contrast. Verify with snapshots and decoded frames.
